# Replatform facts: vendor ties and module dependencies

<!-- provenance -->
> **Extracted fact** from the code at commit `a50f11c`, produced by static analysis with no AI model. Safe to rely on.


Facts about how the code is tied to outside vendors and how its modules depend on each other, for anyone weighing a move to another platform or a restructure. Dependencies are imports and inheritance found by static analysis; dynamic loading, reflection and calls between separately deployed services are not visible to it.

## Dependency layers

Layer 1 modules depend on no other module; each later layer depends only on earlier layers. A layer marked circular contains modules that import each other, so they cannot be separated into layers among themselves.

1. Layer 1: `modules/ships-n-cargo`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/inbound/http`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/ports`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/shared/errors`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/shared/utils`
2. Layer 2: `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/outbound/persistence/errors`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/outbound/projections/errors`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/errors`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/ports/errors`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/use-cases/list-ship-overviews`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/bootstrap/errors`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/shared/domain/errors`

4. Layer 6: `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/outbound/persistence/postgresql`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/adapters/outbound/persistence/sqlite`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/use-cases/change-voyage-destination`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/use-cases/divert-ship`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/use-cases/plan-voyage`, `modules/ships-n-cargo/src/application/use-cases/register-ship`
